schritte.name: hilfe-tour-1
schritte.text:
GETTING-STARTED TOUR · STEP 1 / 7
Welcome to LZ Cable Planner

A short tour shows where the main features live. You can re-open it any time from the Help menu in the top right.

End tour
Back
Next

schritte.name: tour-2
schritte.text:
GETTING-STARTED TOUR · STEP 2 / 7
File menu (top left)

Use "File" to create projects, open saved files and persist changes. Project metadata is editable from "Project properties" there.

End tour
Back
Next

schritte.name: tour-3
schritte.text:
GETTING-STARTED TOUR · STEP 3 / 7
Export menu

The "Export" menu hosts PDF plan export, the cable BOM and two Rentman actions: attach PDF to Rentman and send cables to Rentman.

Tip: The Rentman entries are only active if a Rentman project is linked.
End tour
Back
Next

schritte.name: tour-4
schritte.text:
GETTING-STARTED TOUR · STEP 4 / 7
Settings → Rentman

Save the token, test the connection and link/switch Rentman projects from the "Rentman API" tab in Settings.

End tour
Back
Next

schritte.name: tour-5
schritte.text:
GETTING-STARTED TOUR · STEP 5 / 7
Library on the left

The left column holds equipment, cable library and groups. In the Equipment tab you can switch between local and Rentman-imported devices.

End tour
Back
Next

schritte.name: tour-6
schritte.text:
GETTING-STARTED TOUR · STEP 6 / 7
Properties on the right

Selecting an item on the canvas opens its details and editing tools on the right.

End tour
Back
Next

schritte.name: tour-7
schritte.text:
GETTING-STARTED TOUR · STEP 7 / 7
Cable plan & warnings

If you import cable quantities from Rentman, LZ Cable Planner warns when you wire more cables than available. "Send cables to Rentman" syncs back the assembled totals.

End tour
Back
Let's go

schritte.name: handy-sicherheitshinweise
schritte.text:
Mobile access

Starts a small web server on the local network. Scan the QR code with the phone → the mobile viewer opens in the browser and loads the current project. The server stops automatically when the app closes or via the Stop button. less

Feedback from the phone
Read only
Contribute: ticks, cables, photos, new devices

All write routes are closed — the phone is refused on every write attempt. The plan is changed by the person at the desk.

Server is stopped. Click below to start the LAN server.

Start LAN server
Make system access codes retrievable

This project carries no intercom configuration with access codes.

Security notes
Whether the phone may write back is decided by the setting above. If it is set to “send back ticks, cables and photos”, anyone with the QR code can change the plan.
Every write path requires the token from the QR code. Passwords and keys are stripped from the project before it leaves the device.
The system access codes NEVER travel with the project. They live only in the desktop app's memory and only while the switch above is on; they are retrieved with a second code that is not part of the QR code.
The server binds to the local network (0.0.0.0). If it is unclear who is on the network, prefer stopping it.
When the desktop app closes the server stops automatically.

notizen.handy-mitschreiben:
Mobile access

Starts a small web server on the local network. Scan the QR code with the phone → the mobile viewer opens in the browser and loads the current project. The server stops automatically when the app closes or via the Stop button. less

Feedback from the phone
Read only
Contribute: ticks, cables, photos, new devices

Ticks, on-site cables, reports, photos and new devices go back into the project. Anyone with the QR code can change the plan.

Start LAN server

This project carries no intercom configuration with access codes.

Security notes
notizen.handy-sicherheitshinweise:
Mobile access

Starts a small web server on the local network. Scan the QR code with the phone → the mobile viewer opens in the browser and loads the current project. The server stops automatically when the app closes or via the Stop button. less

Feedback from the phone
Read only
Contribute: ticks, cables, photos, new devices

All write routes are closed — the phone is refused on every write attempt. The plan is changed by the person at the desk.

Server is stopped. Click below to start the LAN server.

Start LAN server
Make system access codes retrievable

This project carries no intercom configuration with access codes.

Security notes
Whether the phone may write back is decided by the setting above. If it is set to “send back ticks, cables and photos”, anyone with the QR code can change the plan.
Every write path requires the token from the QR code. Passwords and keys are stripped from the project before it leaves the device.
The system access codes NEVER travel with the project. They live only in the desktop app's memory and only while the switch above is on; they are retrieved with a second code that is not part of the QR code.
The server binds to the local network (0.0.0.0). If it is unclear who is on the network, prefer stopping it.
When the desktop app closes the server stops automatically.
